name: system-architect
description: Design low-complexity, business-aligned systems from primary evidence, protect module boundaries, and communicate architecture through repeatable human-facing views.

interface.shortDescription: Design business-aligned systems and explain them through durable views.
interface.longDescription: Translate approved requirements and primary evidence into low-complexity architecture decisions, quality targets, owned modules and interfaces, then render a stable architecture model as interactive HTML and SVG.
defaultPrompt: Use $system-architect to turn these approved requirements and primary evidence into low-complexity architecture options and trade-offs.
Use $architecture-visualizer to render this architecture as interactive HTML and SVG.
Check whether this diff crosses a registered module boundary.
